verdict.rationale: Kino generates AI information from the user's own footage inside the product: every clip is transcribed, described shot by shot, and tagged with who appears in it. Its agent also reads that footage to produce cuts and can answer review comments. There is no documented feature that surfaces analytical insights or proactive suggestions, so this AI output is closer to metadata plus agent-executed edits. Missing for 10: an explicit insights/suggestions capability (e.g., recommended edits or highlights surfaced to the user), detailed docs on how AI analysis is presented, and independent hands-on corroboration of the footage-understanding quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Every clip is transcribed, described shot by shot, and knows who’s in it.
The agent reads your footage, makes the edit, and leaves every clip on the timeline for you to move.
Comments land on your timeline, and the agent can answer them.
